purpose: Teach: 夕刻/論外/切り出し/有償/ジョイント/レパートリー/字体/期生

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、夕刻の実験は注意散漫になりがちだ
lines.en: Ren, your focus tends to slip during evening experiments.
lines.style: Measured, steady observation. No blame in the tone. Direct eye contact. The weight of experience behind a simple statement. Speaks as someone who has seen this pattern before and expects it to be understood and corrected.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データ捏造は論外と承知しております
lines.en: Yes. I understand that data fabrication is completely unacceptable.
lines.style: Immediate, serious acknowledgment. No deflection. Sits straighter. The words are clipped slightly—showing he's taken the warning to heart. Quiet conviction underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の本題を切り出して指導教授に相談しろ
lines.en: Ren, bring the main question from your paper to your advisor. Talk it through.
lines.style: Instruction wrapped in permission. Not harsh. A slight lean forward as if saying 'this is how you move forward.' Tone is direct but not cold—guiding, not commanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学術データベースの有償購読を申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit a request to access the paid academic database.
lines.style: Quick, focused response. Shows he's already thinking through the practical step. Formal but not stiff. A slight nod at the end—confirmation that the path is clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、他大学とのジョイント研究を進めろ
lines.en: Ren, move forward with joint research with other universities.
lines.style: Directive without softening. Speaks with the authority of someone guiding a young researcher's trajectory. Brief pause after his name—letting it land. Clear expectation, not suggestion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。発表のレパートリーを広げる練習をしております
lines.en: Yes. I'm practicing expanding my presentation repertoire with my peers.
lines.style: Shows initiative without overstepping. Steady voice. The mention of working with peers is deliberate—demonstrating he's already building the collaboration. Earnest but not anxious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の字体は学会の規定に従え
lines.en: Ren, follow the conference guidelines for your paper's formatting.
lines.style: Final, practical directive. The tone is matter-of-fact—details matter, and this is one of them. Not unkind, but non-negotiable. Assumes compliance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。同期生の研究者と協力します
lines.en: Yes. I'll coordinate with my colleagues on this.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Slightly softer than before—the conversation is closing. Shows understanding and readiness. A small exhale at the end—relief at having been guided clearly, and the resolve to follow through.
